name: Ashish Nagar
testimonial: I had the pleasure of working with Mansi on my CXone Integrated Agent team, and she was an outstanding developer. Once a task was assigned to her, I never had to review or follow up—she consistently delivered on time and at a quality that rarely needed a second look. What set Mansi apart was her technical depth. She understood the systems deeply and confidently offered suggestions that improved how we approached development. Any team would be lucky to have Mansi. I recommend her without hesitation.
